scope: Public documentation of existing open engineering software; documentation confirms availability/features, NOT suitability for a company's product, benchmark performance, or legal permission for any proprietary-format reverse engineering.

facts.subject: FMI standard
facts.claim: FMI defines a public interface for exchange/co-simulation of dynamic models; an official implementer's guide is available.

facts.subject: OpenModelica FMI
facts.claim: OpenModelica documents FMI export/import, with version-specific support/limitations.

facts.subject: OMSimulator
facts.claim: OMSimulator is an FMI/SSP-oriented simulator with API/CLI integration.

facts.subject: Xcos
facts.claim: Xcos provides a block-diagram editor/simulator for hybrid dynamical systems.

facts.subject: FreeCAD
facts.claim: FreeCAD is a parametric CAD modeler and documents STEP/IGES exchange and scripting features.

facts.subject: OCCT
facts.claim: Open CASCADE documents STEP processor import/export support; representation of higher-level design history is separate from basic shape exchange.

facts.subject: OpenROAD
facts.claim: OpenROAD provides an open source RTL-to-GDSII physical design flow infrastructure.

facts.subject: OpenROAD Flow
facts.claim: OpenROAD Flow documentation describes the Yosys/OpenROAD/KLayout toolchain and integration scripts.

facts.subject: KiCad
facts.claim: KiCad handles schematics and PCB layout, a different scope from RTL-to-GDS digital ASIC flow.
